description: This file defines the 'ViewClassic' class extending 'SugarView', responsible for handling the display logic for classic views in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for constructing the view object and displaying the appropriate view files based on user permissions and file existence checks.

classes.name: ViewClassic
classes.description: A view class for rendering classic view pages within SuiteCRM, handling access control and dynamic inclusion of view files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializes the ViewClassic object, setting up the view type based on the action.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the view by checking user permissions and including the relevant PHP file from the module directories.
